channel.title: Celebrity MasterChef
channel.desc: Today, things take a sweet turn, as pastry skills and spectacular creations come to the fore. Nobody should get too comfy, as one more will be heading home. Finals week kicks off with a trip to one of the country's most celebrated potteries, Wedgwood, which is celebrating the 250th anniversary of its most famous clay creations - Jasperware. The celebrities will be serving a delectable afternoon tea for some special guests, including renowned potters and the Lord Mayor of Stoke-on-Trent.
